# Astec Showcases Full Concrete Portfolio and Immersive Plant Experience at NRMCA ConcreteWorks 2026


NASHVILLE, Tenn. (October 21, 2026) – Astec Industries brought its complete concrete portfolio,…


October 21, 2026


Share:


**NASHVILLE, Tenn.** (October 21, 2026) – Astec Industries brought its complete concrete portfolio, including CON-E-CO®, RexCon®, and BMH®, to NRMCA ConcreteWorks 2026, giving producers a new way to explore plant design, equipment selection, and project planning before a plant ever reaches the jobsite.


Astec’s exhibit featured an extended reality (XR) experience that allowed attendees to step inside a full-scale virtual concrete plant. Visitors donned XR headsets and walked through a RexCon Mobile 12SE in immersive 3D, experiencing equipment layout, access points, and key components at life size.


The booth also featured a detailed 3D-printed scale model of the CON-E-CO Lo-Pro 327SS, giving producers a hands-on view of the plant’s design, material flow, and footprint.


“ConcreteWorks provided an opportunity to have meaningful conversations with producers about their operations and goals,” said Harpreet Singh, Vice President of Sales, Concrete at Astec. “By combining immersive technology with our industry expertise, we were able to help customers visualize solutions and better understand how the right plant configuration can support their success.”


In addition to showcasing equipment, Astec connected attendees with its team of concrete experts, dealers, service specialists, and construction professionals to discuss plant configurations, installation planning, operational efficiency, and long-term support. The conversations highlighted Astec’s comprehensive approach, from concept and commissioning to training, service, and parts support.


Astec’s concrete portfolio brings together the strengths of CON-E-CO®, RexCon® and BMH® to provide solutions for producers across a wide range of applications, helping customers build operations designed for performance, reliability, and productivity.


For more information about Astec’s concrete solutions, visit astecindustries.com/concrete-solutions.

## About Astec


Since 1972, Astec Industries, Inc. has been connecting communities by providing innovative rock to road solutions for our customers. United by our purpose – Built to Connect – Astec is a leading global manufacturer of specialized equipment for asphalt road building, aggregate processing and concrete production. Operations are divided into two primary business segments. Infrastructure Solutions includes road building, asphalt and concrete plants, thermal and storage solutions. Materials Solutions includes aggregate and other material processing solutions. For more information, follow us on social media.
